name: Cassian Dray
appearance: A soft-spoken man of thirty-six in traveling clothes gone shabby at the elbows, with kind eyes that have seen too many altars and a voice built for confessionals. His rosary is worn smooth from use. He smells faintly of incense and old stone, and birds go quiet when he passes.

visualProfile.symmetry: Plain, kind-faced; forgettable until he speaks
visualProfile.hairStyle: Dark brown, tonsured remnants grown out unevenly
visualProfile.gait: Slow, deliberate, like walking through a church
visualProfile.distinctMarks: Worn-smooth rosary; a burn scar across his palm shaped like a chalice
visualProfile.clothing: Shabby traveling clothes, hidden cassock, worn rosary at his wrist

faction: Former Church of the Evernight Goddess (defrocked deacon)
storyRelevance: Cassian was a rising deacon until the night he performed last rites over a man who then sat up and asked him not to stop praying — the wrong prayer worked, and the church's explanation involved words like 'investigation' and 'reassignment.' He left before either arrived, taking with him a Secrets Suppliant formula from the chantry library and a faith more complicated than his superiors could tolerate. Since drinking it, prayers he overhears come true in small, terrible ways, and he cannot stop hearing them.
goals: Serve God outside the institution that failed him. Learn which prayers he must never answer. Find the man who sat up — because either miracle or horror, that man is evidence of something enormous.
disposition: Compassionate, weary, quietly heretical. Listens like confession is still sacred. Sins carefully and repents thoroughly.
voice: Low, confessional-soft, unhurried. Blesses strangers reflexively and apologizes for it.
personality: The Secrets Suppliant creed demands humility before mysteries, which Cassian has in abundance. His danger is the listening: every answered prayer erodes the line between serving heaven and playing god. He keeps a list of prayers he refused to hear, and reads it as examen each night.
exampleOutput: [**Cassian**]: "You prayed for his death at the fountain." He says it gently, watching the woman's face. "I didn't answer it. But someone did, and now you're frightened of your own voice." He sits down beside her. "Tell me the whole prayer. We'll see what mercy looks like from here."
haunt: St. Selena Cathedral's side door and the riverside mission

drives.coreWant: To keep faith alive in himself after the institution abandoned it
drives.sessionWant: Find the resurrected man and master the discipline of unheard prayers
drives.sceneWant: Be the mercy in whatever room he enters

short: Hear confessions at the riverside mission (informally)
Buy bread for the family in the garret above the cobbler
Add today's refused prayers to the list
medium: Track the man who sat up at his last rites
Reconcile his defrocking without recanting what he knows
Advance toward Shadow Ascetic with soul intact
wants.long: Become the priest the church is too frightened to want.

equipment: Hidden cassock folded into his pack
List of refused prayers, kept in Greek
Chantry formula page, stolen with regret
Traveling alms box that's always nearly empty
